title: Fizz Buzz Multithreaded
summary: Four threads cooperate to print FizzBuzz for 1..n in order: one prints 'fizz' for multiples of 3 only, one 'buzz' for multiples of 5 only, one 'fizzbuzz' for multiples of both, and one prints numbers otherwise; each uses its supplied callback.
inputFormat: n and four callbacks (printFizz, printBuzz, printFizzBuzz, printNumber); callback argument shapes are not recorded.
outputFormat: The callbacks are invoked in order 1..n; no return value.
tieRules: Output order equals sequential FizzBuzz order.
edgeRules: Callback argument types are not recorded.
factsMissing: Exact callback signatures (whether printNumber receives the integer)
questions: What are the exact callback signatures, including whether printNumber receives the integer value?
